note: Choose each target province's source-population plurality, then merge land-connected uncolonized provinces with the same mapped primary culture across state borders. Seas, other cultures and owned land do not bridge components. Only explicitly source-unowned habitable territory qualifies; no population creation or loss of source-owned territory. Native V3 colonization requirements remain in force.

generated_native_military.basis: Generated source-unowned ethnic components have no source-country military evidence; do not inherit country-specific native_conscription multipliers from the graphics/culture template. Retain ordinary native V3 laws and conscription mechanics. Explicit vanilla population-template countries are exempt.
